items.summary: Recommendation: blocked. Keep SearchWoot private and do not send rights outreach or change monetization. Woot documentation confirms API access but not public redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public data use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates are also blocked. Human counsel is required before any public beta or affiliate/advertising use.

Continue the four open launch-readiness tasks without closing any. Produce one dated read-only bundle containing repository/config data-flow and retention evidence, deployed consent behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, log-field and vendor inventory, and incident/request procedures. Do not change tracking, production, credentials, or configuration.

Security and operations evidence remains incomplete: fleet-doctor has no run and deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Keep public exposure blocked for SearchWoot and provide dated control evidence or explicit unknowns for access, secrets, isolation, TLS, dependencies, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness.

Use only supported values: 2026-09-21 Amazon data shows $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission and $0 site-attributed income. Do not assign aggregate revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift to SearchWoot or other sites without valid identifiers and cost evidence.
